turns.request: I'm stuck on Titan. Get me home to Earth. What are my options?
turns.full_request: I'm stuck on Titan. Get me home to Earth. What are my options?
turns.dispatcher: Intent: {trip: Titan -> Earth, request_date: 2026-10-16, request: list options, objective: unspecified (default energy/cost-efficient), driver: unspecified (compare fleet [SIMULATED] and roadster [real, premium]), budget: unspecified, deadline: unspecified}. Ambiguities: no time or budget preference stated; 'home' taken to mean arrival at Earth (landing and surface transfer are outside the tool's scope); payment currency not stated (no DOGE price given, so fares are in USD only).
turns.broker: You have two verified ways home, and both take a long time. Option 1 is a simulated fleet car (a demo vehicle, not a real one) parked in your Titan orbit: pickup in about 4.8 hours, you leave Titan 2026-10-21 and reach Earth 2032-03-13, 1975 days door to door (5.41 years), fare 1000147.68 USD. Option 2 is the real Roadster, a premium pickup that reaches Titan 2033-08-15 and gets you home 2039-07-15, 4655 days door to door (12.74 years), fare 2376608.64 USD. Both routes passed an n-body re-fly check, with an Earth entry speed of 16.47 km/s on the fleet trip and 15.34 km/s on the Roadster trip. The fares cover energy and time only: landing, aerobraking and life support are not priced, the fleet car's phasing burn is not modelled, and the fleet trip needs a battery_pct of 14837 on a 200 kWh pack with no recharging modelled.

turns.request: Too slow. Faster please, money is no object.
turns.full_request: I'm stuck on Titan. Get me home to Earth. What are my options? Too slow. Faster please, money is no object.
turns.dispatcher: Intent: {trip: Titan -> Earth, request_date: 2026-10-16, objective: time (earliest arrival), budget: unlimited ('money is no object'), driver: any}. Ambiguities: 'faster' has no target date; unlimited money does not mean unlimited risk, so safety limits such as Earth entry speed still apply and should be shown; the rider has not said they accept a dangerous entry. Plan: fastest option with the default burn cap, Roadster fastest for comparison, plus lower burn caps as safer trade-offs.
turns.broker: The fastest verified option is the simulated fleet car at full burn: you leave Titan 2026-10-16 and reach Earth 2028-08-26, 680 days door to door (1.86 years), fare 370472.48 USD. Paying for the real Roadster does not help, because its fastest trip still arrives 2035-06-26 (3175 days). There is a serious catch: the fastest trip hits Earth at 48.96 km/s, compared with 16.47 km/s on the slow trip, and nothing about surviving that entry (aerobraking, heat shield, landing) is modelled or priced, so money cannot make that speed safe. A better trade-off uses a smaller Titan departure burn of 4.997 km/s: you still leave 2026-10-16, arrive 2030-03-09 (1240 days, 3.39 years), enter at 15.97 km/s, and pay 632813.76 USD. A middle option with a 7.926 km/s burn gets you home 2029-07-02 (990 days), but its entry is still 34.64 km/s. All of these passed the n-body check; life support is not priced, and the fleet car's phasing burn and battery recharging are not modelled.
